title: 褲
teacherNotes: Release integration for L220. Latest origin/main is being advanced in playable order, with all prior lessons integrated before this unit, so there are no unresolved provisional learned characters. Production owns the asset-complete lesson-local package; Release owns production JSON, planner, ledger, registry cleanup, final verify, merge, and deploy.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main production JSON through L219 plus current target from newChars
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family identity anchors from L154/L162/L163 when the sentence shows the protagonist girl, protagonist mother, or protagonist father.
Use recurring teacher identity for S04, visually distinct from protagonist mother and from the L058 adult woman.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, school badges, machine labels, or readable marks.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
S03 must show a reminder about not-yet-dry clothes and pants without changing clothes or exposure.
S05 must communicate dry/wet two-use cleaning by scene content, not written labels.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate G02 prefix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和主角媽媽在家中準備去游泳池，主角小女孩把泳褲放進泳具包裡，旁邊可有泳帽或泳鏡。畫面要清楚表現「去游泳池要帶泳褲」；不可有文字、數字或標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 衣服有點濕掉，很快就乾了。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 衣服有點濕掉很快就乾了
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩的衣服被一點水弄濕，主角媽媽在旁邊安撫她，陽光或風吹進來，衣服看起來很快就會乾。畫面要表現只是有點濕、很快變乾，不要像全身淋濕；不可有文字、數字或標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 衣褲還沒乾，不要穿上身。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 衣褲還沒乾不要穿上身
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角媽媽提醒主角小女孩，晾著的衣服和褲子還沒乾，不要穿到身上。主角小女孩伸手看著衣褲但還沒有穿，畫面不能呈現更衣或暴露；不可有文字、數字或標籤。
老師在教室或校園中展示一套校服，包含上衣和長褲，旁邊有主角小女孩和男孩同學在看。老師必須使用 recurring teacher identity，不能長得像主角媽媽。畫面要清楚呈現校服由上衣和長褲組成；不可有文字、校徽字樣、數字或標籤。
主角爸爸在家中展示一台乾濕兩用清潔機，一邊可以處理地上的小水漬，一邊可以清理地上的灰塵或髒東西；主角小女孩在旁邊看。畫面要清楚表現同一台工具可處理乾和濕兩種情況，但不可在機器上出現文字、數字、品牌、標籤或說明牌。

sentenceGamesPlan.reason: 「長褲」是本課清楚的目標字用法，畫面也清楚。
